# Reporting a security problem

If you find a security problem in Liquid Control, such as a way into its pairing or its encrypted Bluetooth link, or
to the passwords and codes it types, please don't open an issue about it: issues here are public.

Report it privately instead. On this repository's Security tab, choose Report a vulnerability, or go straight to
https://github.com/saitokiku/liquid-control/security/advisories/new. Only you and the people who maintain this
repository see what you send there.

If that page doesn't open for you, open an issue that says only that you have a security problem to report, with no
details, and we'll find a private way for you to send them.

It helps to include what you did, what happened, the app version, your phone or watch, and the device it was
controlling.
